note: Sidecar stamp over the UNMODIFIED third-party v2 pack format (microWakeWord manifest + sibling .tflite) — the manifest is never forked; this stamp adds the version/hash surface the flash-time pin verifies. Three-level versions (process/contracts.md §3): a new word extends `pack` (a MINOR cut); replacing a published model file is breaking (a MAJOR cut) because flashed hashes stop verifying; stamp metadata with `pack` untouched is a patch. v1.0.1 (HK-13/BUILD-50, 2026-10-05): a declaration-only patch — `artifacts` is declared EMPTY with a `guard` pointer (the binary-pack sidecar shape: this STAMP is the whole pinned set, the pack bytes live on Hugging Face and never enter a repo). `pack` is byte-for-byte the wake-pack-v1 content — no hash, URL or revision moved.
